remarks: Experience refined living in this beautifully renovated townhouse-style condominium, ideally situated in the heart of New Canaan. Offering four bedrooms, two full bathrooms, and a finished third floor, this exceptional residence combines timeless elegance with modern comfort and effortless functionality. The thoughtfully updated interior features a designer-inspired kitchen with elegant quartz countertops conviniently opens to an expansive deck. Beautifully renovated bathrooms, pristine hardwood floors, and an abundance of natural light throughout. The spacious and versatile layout provides plenty of room for both everyday living and entertaining. The first floor offers a private bedroom and full bathroom, perfect for guests, a home office, or flexible living arrangements. The finished third floor provides additional space that can be tailored to your lifestyle.  Ideally located just moments from New Canaan's brand-new library, charming downtown, acclaimed restaurants and shops, and the train station, this home offers the rare combination of sophisticated living and unparalleled convenience. Plenty of parking space. A truly exceptional opportunity to enjoy the best of New Canaan living.  Qualified tenants only. Good credit, verifiable income, and strong references required. Two months' security deposit and one month's rent in advance required.
